or Yogācārabhūmisūtra or °śāstra or Saptadaśabhūmiśāśtra. Bud. addressed by Bodhisattva Maitreya to Asaṅga. A basic text of the HOSSO. sect. of Buddhism in Japan, by Asaṅga. (4th cent.), brother of Vasubandhu. ref to by Levi, BMFJ. I. i. 33. 49.
